title: 2  Introduction to Thermodynamics
text:
2.1 The First Law of Thermodynamics
Thermodynamics describes the relationships between heat, work, temperature and internal energy.
The first law expresses conservation of energy:
\[
\Delta U = Q - W
\]
where:

title: 2  Introduction to Thermodynamics
text:
\(U\) is the internal energy.
\(Q\) is heat transferred into the system.
\(W\) is work done by the system.

title: 2  Introduction to Thermodynamics
text:
2.2 Worked Example
A gas absorbs 500 J of heat and performs 200 J of work.
The change in internal energy is:
\[
\Delta U = 500 - 200 = 300\ \mathrm{J}
\]
